$comment: Bake config for Constantinople's city view (scripts/build-city-plate.mjs). bbox = [west, south, east, north] in degrees: the detailed plan, from the Theodosian walls to Chalcedon and from the Marmara to the upper Golden Horn. outerBbox: the outer ground (land mask and coast), the whole DEM crop. metresPerPixel sets the working grid. seaFixes are rings (lon/lat) forced to sea: modern fills that did not exist before 1453. landFixes are forced to land. Heights are metres; the DEM is the z13 Terrarium mosaic beside this file.
